assemblies.name: MYB161_TreeAssembly_A
assemblies.role: Plan A foreground left ancient trunk frame
assemblies.notes: Foreground left frame. Big asymmetrical trunk, wider roots and grouped supported canopy lobes preserve the lush near-camera enclosure without closing the route.

assemblies.name: MYB161_TreeAssembly_B
assemblies.role: Plan B near left canopy reinforcement
assemblies.notes: Near left support mass. Keeps the baseline green tunnel feeling by adding supported canopy grouping instead of another isolated prop.

assemblies.name: MYB161_TreeAssembly_C
assemblies.role: Plan C mid-left forest enclosure mass
assemblies.notes: Mid-left enclosure mass. Restores the feeling of riding through a forest while staying outside the readable route corridor.

meshyAssets.family: Plan D hero root arch natural gate
meshyAssets.notes: Plan D. Existing MYB-160 root arch placed diagonally as the single lateral natural threshold, reduced so it reads as a gate without becoming a noisy wall.
